invariants.rule: Static plans, schemas, fixtures, generated concepts, validators, catalogs, and planned wiring are not native runtime, visual, performance, migration, security, or readiness proof.
Every canonical command and typed local UI action in the retained touched inventories resolves to exactly one Touch Closure row.
A row remains partial, blocked, or missing while its native handler, production wiring, test, or admitted runtime evidence is absent.
Concept JavaScript is simulation evidence only and never a Rust or Slint native handler claim.
Every action has one canonical owner and one handler route; aliases normalize before dispatch and never receive a second lifecycle.
Every GUI-required command has a visible consumer and every visible control has an exact command or typed local UI action, availability selector, and disabled reason.
Events remain non-emitting candidates until Event Authority admission; receipt-only effects must say so explicitly.
Doctor and Settings route to domain owners and never privately probe, install, authenticate, repair, update, move storage, browse, back up, restore, or operate source control.
AuthBrowserSession is human-only, non-recordable, non-inspectable, and unavailable to agents, adapters, capture, Browser Programs, and ordinary browser controls.

Duplicate action IDs, duplicate owners, orphan controls, commands without handler routes, handler routes without actions, reverse-wiring gaps, stale PlanUnits, incomplete profiles, and unapproved disposition values fail validation.

Closed owner action inventories are extracted from stable owner sections or machine schemas and must match their exact admitted sets; mutable prose-sentence drift cannot erase a family or turn the remaining Touch Closure rows into false orphans.
